original.title: Exact commutation criterion for two MEX insertion factors
original.statement: P_A P_B=P_B P_A for every finite context iff A△B⊆{0,…,mex(A∪B)−1}.

exactAuditedStatement: For finite journals A, B subset N0, maps P_G(S)=S union{mex(G union S)} commute on every finite contextS iff A symmetric_difference B subset{0,..., c-1}, c=mex(A union B).
hypotheses: All finite contexts; equality of carrier maps, not owner memories.
independentDerivationAndChecks: Put a=mex(A union S), b=mex(B union S). If a<b, adding a cannot change B mex b because a was already B-banned or in S; adding b cannot change A mex a. Thus both orders yield{a, b}. Symmetric argument handles a>b.
If a=b=t, t is outside A union B and hence t>=c. If all disagreements are<c, journals agree above t, while all labels belowt were blocked. After first service t, both second MEX values coincide.

If a disagreement u exists at/above c, then u>c since c belongs neither journal. Let S={0,..., u}minus{c, u}. Both first MEX values are c; after c the owner allowing u emits u, the other cannot. The two order response sets differ. This also handles c0 and empty journals without special exceptions.
